verdict.rationale: An official built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a 3D engine or library ecosystem, since three.js ships its own editor, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only machine-readable docs for external LLMs (llms.txt, llms-full.txt) and explicitly states there is no three.js MCP. Nothing shows an official assistant inside the editor or library that generates scripts, answers API questions or scaffolds scenes.
